question:
According to Dalton, which of the following represents the Phosphorus element?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1ec679904f041f7a4d817946d504097ca595b3b68b5e38a29533305a9426eb3.png]
solution:
The correct answer is __**c**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **John Dalton**, in his **atomic theory**, proposed a system of symbols to represent various chemical elements.
 
• He used simple shapes and patterns, often circles, to illustrate atoms of different elements.
 
• His system was one of the earliest attempts to represent elements and compounds visually, although it was **later replaced by modern chemical symbols**.
 
• The symbol for **Phosphorus was a circle divided into three sections or parts**, similar to the peace symbol, as shown in option C in the image.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ae4a5e0681b0e39499bd9f77d4e6d7427ca5ddfabea9257ae8f8cc0a2d90a9a.png] 
 
• The circle with lines representing a division was how Dalton chose to represent the atomic structure of phosphorus.
 
• This design aligns with** Dalton’s early visual method of distinguishing between different atoms**, with each shape or pattern corresponding to a particular element.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chemical symbols **are the **abbreviations **used in **chemistry for chemical elements**, **functional groups, **and **chemical compounds**.
 
• **Element symbols **for **chemical elements **normally consist of **one or two letters **from the **Latin alphabet **and are written with the **first letter capitalised**.
 
• **A chemical symbol **is a **one- or two-letter **designation of **an element**.
 
• **A chemical symbol **is a **one- or two-letter designation **of **an element**.
 
• Some examples of **chemical symbols **are **O for oxygen**, **Zn for zinc**, **H for hydrogen, **and **Fe for iron**. 
 
• **The first letter **of **a symbol **is **always capitalized**. If the **symbol contains two letters**, **the second letter **is **lowercase**.
